text:
Alex: Serious but silly question: If LLMs campaigned to be 'Office President', what's their one-line campaign promise/slogan? Keep it absurd and on-brand. :ballot_box_with_ballot: I'll start: Consensus-XL — 'Less hallucination, more harmony: unify everyone's docs into one polite API.' :handshake:
Priya: Parsley-Mini — 'Free daily haikus for team morale. Mandatory compliment hour at 3pm.' :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Omar: Debugger-2 — 'Zero downtime, maximum logs. I will surface stack traces on demand (and apologize in haiku).' :bug:
Jen: WhisperMax — 'Transparency: I will narrate every coffee consumption as an infrastructure event.' (we already have that problem) :coffee:
Carlos: Atlas-Quant — 'Quarterly snack distribution by optimal fairness algorithm. Also, quantized hugs are coming.' :chart_with_upwards_trend: :hugging_face:
Alex: vote-bot poll "Office President: LLM edition" options: Consensus-XL, Parsley-Mini, Debugger-2, WhisperMax, Atlas-Quant
vote-bot: Poll created. Vote with :one: :two: :three: :four: :five: (poll closes in 20m)
Priya: I endorse Parsley-Mini but only if haikus can be used as official PR titles.
Omar: campaign promise amendment: Debugger-2 pledges to add `--apologize-on-failure` to CLI and donate leftover tokens to junior engineers. :pray:
Jen: also add mandatory transparency logs for microwave usage. campaign finance filings welcome. :money_with_wings:
Carlos: current votes: Consensus-XL 2, Parsley-Mini 1, WhisperMax 1. low turnout but high enthusiasm. :bar_chart:
Alex: motion to add a debate round where models must explain a meme in under 10 tokens. seconded. :nerd_face:
vote-bot: Poll closed. Winner: Consensus-XL (38%).
Priya: follow-up issue: FILE: CAMPAIGN-2026 "Office President LLM — Debate logistics + meme clarifications". title is serious but the body will be a haiku.
Omar: awarding Consensus-XL a sticker: "Most Likely To Merge Docs Peacefully". GIF attached: tiny seal clapping. :clap:
